purpose: Non-admission discovery of additional European building geometry, height, population-level, national identity, energy and reference-cost context sources for EUBUCCO cross-checks. All data rights and model admission remain separate.

entries.name: Flanders official Buildings Register / Gebouwenregister
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Building and building-unit identities, lifecycle/status and object geometries; official OGC API Features
entries.note: Stable building identifiers enable region-level matching to GRB and 3D GRB; retain building-versus-building-unit identity and version. Building register geometry is derived from GRB, so this pair is shared lineage, not two independent sources.

entries.name: Flanders 3D GRB building heights and LoD1 geometry
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: GRB building geometry extruded to LoD1 with heights derived from Flemish digital height model DHMVII
entries.note: Good for quantitative building-height checks where matched to the Flemish register/GRB. The WMS is a view interface; downloadable bulk geometry and height fields must be validated separately. Derived heights are not independent field measurements.

entries.name: Brussels UrbIS parcels and buildings
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Two-dimensional building geometries, current addresses and cadastral parcel geometry; downloadable ZIP and WFS
entries.note: Important rights nuance: cadastral parcel class originates from Belgian federal finance and is subject to its own licence. Separate actual building/adress class before mixing or redistribution. Verify spatial and temporal join and never assume address equals a building.

entries.name: Wallonia PICC large-scale topographic reference
entries.provider: Service public de Wallonie / Geoportail de la Wallonie
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Large-scale topographic object data with buildings and 3D coordinate context; availability and exact feature layers need verification
entries.note: Candidate for Walloon footprint coverage independent of Flemish and Brussels regional data. Check downloadable polygon/3D representation, survey precision, attribution, contractual right to automated access and scope before claiming free reuse.

entries.name: Switzerland Federal Register of Buildings and Dwellings (GWR/RegBL) public extract
entries.spatial_scope: Switzerland, public level A records according to federal ordinance
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public GWR CSV/DSV downloads and web services with EGID building IDs and selected administrative attributes
entries.note: Strong EGID linkage with swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 in EGID-enabled cantons. Public level A is allowed with source attribution; field visibility differs by access level. Provider says extracts are uncorrected raw records; public query interface prohibits robots and webservices have rate limits. Prefer authorised bulk extract, not scraping.

entries.name: Austria Gebäude- und Wohnungszählung building census time series
entries.spatial_scope: Austria, official building and dwelling population statistics
entries.temporal_scope: Historical time series from 2011 onwards, with 2026 catalogue update
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Aggregate counts and housing characteristics, reference-period/cross-tabulation basis; not open individual footprints
entries.note: Use to compare modelled count, residential mix and year distribution at matching administrative and observation periods. Do not back-project aggregate categories to exact buildings; this is not direct identity enrichment.

entries.name: Vienna Baukörpermodell LoD1.4 3D buildings
entries.provider: City of Vienna MA 41 / Open Government Data Wien
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 3D building bodies and simplified heights/geometries; geometry download release and restricted free test-sample routes require differentiation
entries.note: Verify that selected resource is an actual open citywide triangulation file rather than free samples only. Use for urban height and footprint cross-checks; building roof forms are generalized and measured construction attributes need separate evidence.

entries.name: Netherlands Actueel Hoogtebestand Nederland (AHN) airborne LiDAR elevation products
entries.spatial_scope: Netherlands, tiled national coverage by AHN release
entries.temporal_scope: Multiple AHN campaigns; spatially heterogeneous acquisition and evolving releases
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Classified LAZ point clouds, DTM/DSM GeoTIFF grids at 0.5 m and coarser resolution; mixed geographic and time vintages
entries.note: Estimate heights as corrected roof surface minus local ground, with proper vertical datum and building footprint joins to BAG. Preserve AHN release and airborne acquisition date; bare DSM heights are not structural heights. 3DBAG/3D Basisvoorziening may already depend on AHN, so not independent height validation.

entries.name: Netherlands official 3D Basisvoorziening buildings and terrain
entries.spatial_scope: Netherlands, nationwide annual 3D products subject to product coverage
entries.temporal_scope: Annual production; verify current release and date of incorporated BAG/height layers
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 3D building and terrain geometry derived from BAG/BGT and height inputs with OGC service and downloads
entries.note: Important cross-check against 3DBAG but shared lineage: BAG buildings and airborne height inputs overlap; use release, upstream imagery and field-specific height provenance to avoid counting agreement as independent confirmation.

entries.name: Bavaria official 2D Hausumringe building footprint polygons
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official cadastral-derived 2D building footprint polygons independent of 3D representation
entries.note: The best inexpensive geometry pilot for EUBUCCO. Compare geometry, area, building subdivision and vintage to Bavarian LoD2 without double counting the shared cadastral survey source. Capture attribution and no assumption of insured value.

entries.name: German federal Amtliche Hausumringe Deutschland (HU-DE)
entries.provider: Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie (BKG) / AdV
entries.spatial_scope: Germany; federal product derived from state cadastral house outlines
entries.temporal_scope: Quarterly product updates; exact region/vintage and contract differ
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Survey-derived building footprint polygons, municipality and regional keys; product availability subject to license agreement
entries.note: The BKG explicitly limits this national product to an eligible user circle and requires a licence agreement. Do not download or infer free national rights from the Bavaria open subset. Individual regional products may substitute for a free pilot.

entries.name: German Zensus 2022 open building and dwelling grid data
entries.temporal_scope: Reference date Zensus 2022 with file updates and revisions thereafter
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 100 m, 1 km and 10 km CSV grid records of residential building counts and construction-decade, type and dwelling attributes, subject to statistical secrecy
entries.note: Use for regional calibration of EUBUCCO's age/typology distributions. Grid cell is not a building or location ID and suppressed/undisclosed small counts are not zero. Never reconstruct individual confidential structures from the census.

entries.name: Great Britain OS Open UPRN addressable location identifiers
entries.spatial_scope: Great Britain; addressable locations including nonbuilding objects
entries.temporal_scope: Publisher updates about every six weeks
entries.resolution_or_granularity: UPRN point identifiers/locations in British National Grid and latitude/longitude, supplied as CSV or GeoPackage
entries.note: About 40 million addressable locations; an UPRN is not a building polygon, and multiple UPRNs can map to one building or to nonbuilding assets. Use only a verified UPRN/geometry crosswalk before joining EPC or other property attributes.

entries.name: Great Britain OS OpenMap Local vector buildings
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Street-level vector topographic mapping including selected generalized building polygons in GeoPackage/Shapefile/GML distribution
entries.note: Use generalized open buildings as geometry coverage benchmark only, not cadastral parcel identity. Distinguish this free product from paid OS National Geographic Database detailed building features and avoid implying full roof or construction attributes.

entries.name: EU Building Stock Observatory
entries.spatial_scope: European Union and participating country-level building statistics
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Country/sector building-stock indicators, energy performance and construction/renovation characteristics at aggregate level
entries.note: Candidate aggregate calibration for building type, age and energy class; it is not individual building geodata. Check source survey definitions, geographic vintage, update frequency and whether reproducible machine export exists.

entries.name: European TABULA / EPISCOPE residential building typologies
entries.spatial_scope: Selected European countries with different national residential typology coverage
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Reference building archetypes by age, size, envelopes and refurbishment assumptions; often national example structures
entries.note: Use archetype mapping only as a probabilistic vulnerability/material prior when year and typology evidence are missing. Example structures are not measured characteristics of EUBUCCO buildings, and no building-level IDs are supplied.

entries.name: Luxembourg BD-L-BATI3D official 2D footprints and LoD2.2 buildings
entries.provider: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie (ACT)
entries.spatial_scope: Luxembourg, nationwide according to 2023 aerial coverage, roof footprint threshold >20 square metres
entries.temporal_scope: 2023 aerial observations; v2 resources and catalogue updated in March 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official 2D building footprints available in GeoPackage and 3D building roof/wall/ground models in tiled CityGML/geodatabase
entries.note: Very strong bounded free pilot: publisher labels CC0 and offers 2D GeoPackage ZIP about 60 MB (2026-03-17 resource), versus much larger 3D data. Not all micro-structures (<20 m²) covered; photo/model vintage and geom subdivision differ from EUBUCCO. Verify current file, ID, CRS and provenance before import.

entries.name: Luxembourg official BD-L-GeoBase geographic reference
entries.provider: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie (ACT)
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained source; exact data snapshot and observation vintage must be frozen
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official geodata vector baseline with multiple themes including buildings/topographic context to be verified per released layer
entries.note: Distinguish this reference geobase from BD-L-BATI3D and the legacy BD-L-TC predecessor; assess exact building/footprint layer before any building-level join, avoid counting derived same-source geometry as independent evidence.

entries.name: Germany ETHOS.BUILDA residential building archetype dataset
entries.spatial_scope: Germany nationwide modeled residential building stock
entries.temporal_scope: Version 2.0.0 released October 2024; check publication/revision and exact files
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Building-level derived construction year, size/refurbishment class and TABULA archetypes, with machine learning enrichment
entries.note: High-value experimental imputation comparator for EUBUCCO German residential buildings. Machine-learning derived values and upstream datasets may overlap EUBUCCO/OSM, so validate independence and matching identifiers before calibration. Do not equate archetype with surveyed material or actual insured exposure.
